title: B1 yakuniy imtihon
goal_uz: Dars oxirida B1 darajasining barcha mavzularini takrorlaysiz, imtihon strategiyalarini qo‘llaysiz, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish topshiriqlarini bajarasiz hamda 15 savolli testdan o‘tasiz.

scenes.title: B1 yakuniy imtihoniga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bu B1 darajasining yakuniy darsi. Oldingi darsda muammo va yechim haqida gapirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa butun darajani birga takrorlaymiz: zamonlar, shart gaplar, majhul daraja, ko‘chirma gap, fikr bildirish, hikoya qilish, xat va qisqacha mazmun. Har bir blokdan keyin vaqtga qarab mashq qilamiz. Dars oxirida o‘n beshta savolli test topshirasiz va ikki daqiqalik nutq tayyorlaysiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to the final lesson of level B1. Today we review everything you have learned, practise under exam conditions, and finish with a fifteen-question test.
scenes.say_uz: B1 darajasining yakuniy darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun o‘rgangan barcha narsani takrorlaymiz, imtihon sharoitida mashq qilamiz va o‘n besh savolli test bilan yakunlaymiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
scenes.say_native: Strategiya juda muhim. Birinchi: topshiriq shartini ikki marta o‘qing, ko‘pchilik xatoni shu yerda qiladi. Ikkinchi: oson savollardan boshlang, qiyinini keyinga qoldiring. Uchinchi: hech qachon javobni bo‘sh qoldirmang, test bo‘lsa taxmin qilish ham ball berishi mumkin. To‘rtinchi: oxirida qisqa tekshiruv o‘tkazing: zamon to‘g‘rimi, fe’lga s qo‘shilganmi, artikl o‘rnidami. Bu uch daqiqa bir necha ballni saqlab qoladi.
scenes.say: First, read the instruction twice. Second, answer the easy questions first. Third, never leave an answer blank. Finally, check the tense, the s ending and the article.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi, topshiriqni ikki marta o‘qing. Ikkinchi, oson savollardan boshlang. Uchinchi, javobni bo‘sh qoldirmang. Oxirida zamon, s qo‘shimchasi va artiklni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Zamonlar tizimi: takrorlash
board: Future: will · going to · present continuous

examples.t: I usually walk to work, but today I'm taking the bus.
examples.uz: Odatda ishga piyoda boraman, lekin bugun avtobusda ketyapman.

examples.t: By the time we arrived, the film had started.
examples.uz: Biz yetib borgunimizcha, film boshlanib bo‘lgan edi.

scenes.say_native: Zamonlarni jadval emas, vaqt chizig‘i sifatida eslang. Present simple odatlar uchun, present continuous hozir yoki vaqtinchalik holat uchun. Past simple tugagan voqea, past continuous o‘sha paytda davom etayotgan harakat. Present perfect natijasi hozirga bog‘liq tajriba, past perfect esa o‘tmishdagi ikki voqeadan oldingisi. Kelasi zamon uchun will qaror yoki bashorat, going to reja, present continuous esa kelishilgan uchrashuv uchun ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Think of a timeline. Present simple is for habits, present continuous for now. Past perfect shows the earlier of two past events. Will is for decisions, going to is for plans.
scenes.say_uz: Zamonlarni vaqt chizig‘i deb tasavvur qiling. Present simple odatlar uchun, present continuous hozirgi payt uchun. Past perfect ikki o‘tmish voqeadan oldingisini ko‘rsatadi. Will qaror, going to reja uchun.

scenes.title: Zamonlardagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “yashayapman” so‘zi ham hozirgi, ham davom etayotgan holat uchun ishlatiladi, shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “I am living here since 2019” deydi. Bu xato. Since yoki for bilan davom etayotgan holat present perfect talab qiladi. Ikkinchi xato: yet bilan past simple ishlatish. Yet va already, ever, just kabi so‘zlar bilan present perfect kerak.
scenes.say: Not: I am living here since 2019. Say: I have lived here since 2019. Not: I didn't see him yet. Say: I haven't seen him yet.
scenes.say_uz: Emas: I am living here since 2019. To‘g‘risi: I have lived here since 2019. Emas: I didn't see him yet. To‘g‘risi: I haven't seen him yet.

scenes.title: Zamonni tanlang
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap bor, qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri zamonda ayting. Har birida belgi so‘zni toping: since, when, tomorrow va when she came. Javobni baland ovozda ayting, keyin keyingi blokda tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Number one: she, work, here since May. Number two: when I called, he, sleep. Number three: I, meet, him tomorrow at five. Number four: we, already eat, when she came.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: u may oyidan beri shu yerda ishlaydi. Ikkinchi: men qo‘ng‘iroq qilganimda u uxlayotgan edi. Uchinchi: ertaga beshda uchrashaman. To‘rtinchi: u kelganda biz allaqachon ovqatlangan edik.

scenes.title: Javoblar: zamonlar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: has worked, chunki since bilan present perfect. Ikkinchi: was sleeping, chunki qo‘ng‘iroq paytida davom etayotgan harakat. Uchinchi: am meeting, chunki ertaga kelishilgan uchrashuv, present continuous. To‘rtinchi: had already eaten, chunki ovqatlanish u kelishidan oldin tugagan. Agar to‘rttadan uchtasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, zamonlar bo‘limi sizda mustahkam.
scenes.say: One: she has worked here since May. Two: he was sleeping. Three: I am meeting him tomorrow at five. Four: we had already eaten when she came.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: has worked. Ikki: was sleeping. Uch: am meeting. To‘rt: had already eaten.

scenes.title: Shart gaplar: to‘rt tur

examples.t: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
If I had more time, I would learn Chinese.
examples.uz: Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa, xitoy tilini o‘rgangan bo‘lardim.

examples.t: If she had studied, she would have passed.

scenes.say_native: Shart gaplar to‘rt turga bo‘linadi. Nol turi doimiy haqiqat uchun. Birinchi tur kelajakda real imkoniyat uchun. Ikkinchi tur hozirgi xayoliy yoki ehtimoli kam holat uchun, bu yerda if dan keyin o‘tgan zamon keladi, lekin ma’nosi hozirgi. Uchinchi tur o‘tmishdagi o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydigan voqea uchun. O‘zbekchada “-sa” qo‘shimchasi hammasiga ishlatiladi, inglizchada esa shakl farq qiladi.
scenes.say: There are four types of conditional. Zero for facts, first for real future possibilities, second for unreal present situations, and third for imaginary past situations.
scenes.say_uz: Shart gaplar to‘rt xil: nol turi faktlar uchun, birinchi tur real kelajak uchun, ikkinchi tur xayoliy hozirgi holat uchun, uchinchi tur xayoliy o‘tmish uchun.

scenes.title: If dan keyin will
board: ✗ If it will rain, we will stay.
✓ If it rains, we will stay.
✗ If I would have time, I would go.
✓ If I had time, I would go.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: if dan keyin will yoki would qo‘yish. O‘zbekchada “yomg‘ir yog‘sa” deyiladi va kelasi zamon qo‘shimchasi kerak emas, ammo ko‘p o‘quvchilar tarjima qilib will qo‘shib yuboradi. Qoida oddiy: if qismida will va would bo‘lmaydi. Will yoki would faqat natija qismida keladi. Poyga qoidasi shu: if dan keyin zamon bir qadam orqaga.
scenes.say: Remember: no will and no would after if. If it rains, we will stay. If I had time, I would go.
scenes.say_uz: Eslab qoling: if dan keyin will ham would ham kelmaydi. If it rains, we will stay. If I had time, I would go.

scenes.title: Shart gapni to‘ldiring
board: 1) If I ___ rich, I would travel.
3) If he ___ earlier, he would have caught the train.
4) Water ___ if you heat it to 100°.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchisi: if I, rich, I would travel. Ikkinchisi: if you, hard, you will pass. Uchinchisi: if he, earlier, he would have caught the train. To‘rtinchisi: water, if you heat it to one hundred degrees. Qaysi tur ekanini avval aniqlang, keyin so‘zni ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: if I, blank, rich, I would travel. Number two: if you, blank, hard, you will pass. Number three: if he, blank, earlier, he would have caught the train. Number four: water, blank, if you heat it to one hundred degrees.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: boy bo‘lsam, sayohat qilardim. Ikkinchi: qattiq o‘qisangiz, o‘tasiz. Uchinchi: u ertaroq chiqqanida, poyezdga ulgurgan bo‘lardi. To‘rtinchi: suv yuz darajada qaynaydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: shart gaplar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: were yoki was. Ikkinchi tur, shuning uchun o‘tgan zamon shakli, rasmiyroq uslubda “if I were” deyiladi. Ikkinchi: work, chunki birinchi tur va if dan keyin oddiy hozirgi zamon. Uchinchi: had left, uchinchi tur, past perfect. To‘rtinchi: boils, bu nol turi, ilmiy haqiqat. Oxirgisini ko‘pchilik “will boil” deb xato qiladi.
scenes.say: One: if I were rich. Two: if you work hard. Three: if he had left earlier. Four: water boils at one hundred degrees.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: were. Ikki: work. Uch: had left. To‘rt: boils.

scenes.title: Majhul daraja
board: The report must be finished today.

examples.t: English is spoken all over the world.
The window was broken last night.
The room is being cleaned now.

scenes.say_native: Majhul darajada ish bajaruvchi emas, ish natijasi muhim bo‘ladi. Shakli: be fe’lining kerakli zamoni plus fe’lning uchinchi shakli. O‘zbekchada bu “-ildi, -ildi” qo‘shimchalariga o‘xshaydi: qurildi, sindirildi. Modal bilan ishlatilsa: must be finished. Bundan tashqari have something done qurilmasi bor: I had my hair cut, ya’ni sochimni kesdirdim. Bajaruvchini ko‘rsatish kerak bo‘lsa, by dan foydalanamiz.
scenes.say: We use the passive when the action matters more than the person. Form it with be plus the past participle. It is spoken, it was built, it is being cleaned.
scenes.say_uz: Majhul darajada harakat ish bajaruvchidan muhimroq bo‘ladi. U be plus fe’lning uchinchi shakli bilan yasaladi.

scenes.title: Majhul darajadagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato bor. Birinchisi: be fe’lini tashlab ketish, “The house built in 1900”. O‘zbekchada bog‘lama kerak emas, inglizchada esa shart. Ikkinchisi: majhul daraja yasalmaydigan fe’llarda uni yasash. Happen, arrive, die, occur kabi o‘timsiz fe’llar majhul bo‘lmaydi. “It was happened” deyish noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “It happened”.
scenes.say: Do not forget the verb be: The house was built in 1900. And do not use the passive with verbs like happen: It happened yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: Be fe’lini unutmang: The house was built in 1900. Happen kabi fe’llar bilan majhul daraja ishlatilmaydi: It happened yesterday.

scenes.title: Majhul darajaga o‘tkazing
board: 1) They make cars here. → Cars ___ here.
2) Someone stole my bike. → My bike ___.
3) They are repairing the road. → The road ___.
4) We must send the form. → The form ___.
scenes.say_native: Faol gapni majhul darajaga o‘tkazing. Birinchi gap: cars, here. Ikkinchi gap: my bike. Uchinchi: the road, hozir davom etayotgan harakat. To‘rtinchi: modal bilan, the form must. Zamonni saqlang, faqat tuzilmani o‘zgartiring.
scenes.say: One: They make cars here. Two: Someone stole my bike. Three: They are repairing the road. Four: We must send the form. Change each into the passive.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni majhul darajaga o‘tkazing. Ularning avtomobillari bu yerda ishlab chiqariladi, velosipedim o‘g‘irlandi, yo‘l tuzatilmoqda, shakl yuborilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Javoblar: majhul daraja
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: cars are made here, hozirgi oddiy zamon. Ikkinchi: my bike was stolen, o‘tgan oddiy zamon. Uchinchi: the road is being repaired, hozirgi davomli zamonda being kerak. To‘rtinchi: the form must be sent, modal fe’ldan keyin be va uchinchi shakl. Eng ko‘p adashiladigani uchinchisi, chunki being so‘zi esdan chiqadi.
scenes.say: Cars are made here. My bike was stolen. The road is being repaired. The form must be sent.
scenes.say_uz: Avtomobillar bu yerda ishlab chiqariladi. Velosipedim o‘g‘irlandi. Yo‘l tuzatilmoqda. Shakl yuborilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirma gap
board: Present → past: 'I am tired.' → He said he was tired.
Questions: if / whether + normal word order

examples.t: 'I'm leaving,' she said. → She said she was leaving.
'Where do you live?' → He asked where I lived.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘chirma gapda ko‘pincha zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi: hozirgi zamon o‘tgan zamonga, o‘tgan zamon past perfectga, will would ga, can could ga o‘tadi. Olmoshlar va vaqt so‘zlari ham o‘zgaradi: today o‘rniga that day, tomorrow o‘rniga the next day. Savollarda so‘z tartibi oddiy gap kabi bo‘ladi va do yordamchi fe’li tushib qoladi. Ha yoki yo‘q savollarida if yoki whether qo‘shiladi.
scenes.say: In reported speech the tense usually moves one step back. Am becomes was, will becomes would. In reported questions we use normal word order, with no do.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chirma gapda zamon odatda bir qadam orqaga suriladi. Savollarda so‘z tartibi oddiy gapniki kabi bo‘ladi, do tushib qoladi.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirma gap xatolari
board: ✗ He asked me where did I live.
✓ He asked me where I lived.
✗ She said me she was tired.
✓ She told me she was tired.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita klassik xato. Birinchisi: ko‘chirma savolda so‘roq tartibini saqlash, “where did I live”. Ko‘chirma savol oddiy gapga aylanadi: where I lived. Ikkinchisi: say va tell farqi. Say dan keyin tinglovchi to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kelmaydi, tell dan keyin esa kishi kerak. Demak, she said she was tired yoki she told me she was tired, lekin “said me” emas.
scenes.say: Not: He asked me where did I live. Say: He asked me where I lived. Say has no object. Tell needs one: She told me she was tired.
scenes.say_uz: Emas: He asked me where did I live. To‘g‘risi: He asked me where I lived. Say dan keyin kishi kelmaydi, tell dan keyin kishi kerak.

scenes.title: Ko‘chiring
board: 1) 'I will call you.' → She said she ___.
2) 'I've lost my keys.' → He said he ___.
3) 'Do you like tea?' → She asked me ___.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘chirma gapga aylantiring. Birinchi: I will call you, she said. Ikkinchi: I have lost my keys. Uchinchi: Do you like tea? Bu savol, shuning uchun if ishlating. To‘rtinchi: buyruq, don't be late, bunda to va infinitiv kerak bo‘ladi. Javobingizni ayting.
scenes.say: One: I will call you. Two: I have lost my keys. Three: Do you like tea? Four: Don't be late. Report each one.
scenes.say_uz: Har birini ko‘chirma gapga aylantiring: seni chaqiraman, kalitlarimni yo‘qotdim, choy yoqadimi, kech qolma.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ko‘chirma gap
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: she said she would call me, will would ga o‘tdi, you esa me ga. Ikkinchi: he said he had lost his keys, present perfect past perfectga o‘tdi. Uchinchi: she asked me if I liked tea. To‘rtinchi: he told us not to be late, buyruq inkori not to bilan keladi. Bu so‘nggisini ko‘p kishi unutadi.
scenes.say: She said she would call me. He said he had lost his keys. She asked me if I liked tea. He told us not to be late.
scenes.say_uz: U meni chaqirishini aytdi. U kalitlarini yo‘qotganini aytdi. U choy yoqishini so‘radi. U kech qolmaslikni aytdi.

scenes.title: Lug‘at: ibora fe’llar va hamroh so‘zlar
board: Phrasal verbs: give up, look after, turn down
Collocations: make a decision, do homework

examples.t: She gave up smoking last year.
We need to make a decision.

scenes.say_native: Lug‘at bo‘limida uch narsa tekshiriladi. Birinchisi: ibora fe’llar, masalan give up tashlamoq, look after qaramoq, turn down rad etmoq. Ular alohida ma’noga ega, so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang. Ikkinchisi: hamroh so‘zlar. Inglizlar make a decision deydi, do a decision demaydi; do homework, make a mistake. Uchinchisi: so‘z yasash. Qo‘shimchalar yordamida ot, sifat yoki inkorni yasaysiz.
scenes.say: Three things matter in vocabulary: phrasal verbs, collocations and word formation. She gave up smoking. We need to make a decision.
scenes.say_uz: Lug‘atda uchta narsa muhim: ibora fe’llar, hamroh so‘zlar va so‘z yasash. U chekishni tashladi. Biz qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirish
board: On the one hand … on the other hand …

examples.t: In my opinion, public transport should be free.
examples.uz: Fikrimcha, jamoat transporti bepul bo‘lishi kerak.

examples.t: I see your point, but it would cost too much.
examples.uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin bu juda qimmatga tushadi.

scenes.say_native: Fikr bildirishning formulasi oddiy: fikr, sabab, misol. In my opinion yoki I'd say that bilan boshlang, because bilan sabab keltiring va qisqa misol bering. Boshqa nuqtai nazarni ham ko‘rsating: on the one hand, on the other hand. Rozi bo‘lmaganda ham muloyim bo‘ling: I see your point, but. Faqat I think deb takrorlayvermang, ibora doirangizni kengaytiring.
scenes.say: Use a simple formula: opinion, reason, example. Start with in my opinion. Disagree politely: I see your point, but it would cost too much.
scenes.say_uz: Oddiy formula: fikr, sabab, misol. Rozi bo‘lmasangiz ham muloyim bo‘ling: fikringizni tushunaman, lekin bu juda qimmatga tushadi.

scenes.title: Hikoya qilish
board: Past simple + past continuous + past perfect

examples.t: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When I got there, the shop had closed.
examples.uz: U yerga yetib borganimda do‘kon yopilib bo‘lgan edi.

scenes.say_native: Hikoya uchun uchta zamon kerak. Past simple asosiy voqealarni ketma-ket aytadi. Past continuous fonni beradi: nima davom etayotgan edi. Past perfect esa oldin bo‘lib o‘tganini ko‘rsatadi. Voqealarni first, then, after that, in the end kabi bog‘lovchilar bilan tartibga soling. Ichki his-tuyg‘uni ham qo‘shing: luckily, unfortunately. Shunda hikoya jonli chiqadi.
scenes.say: Use three tenses in a story. The past simple gives the main events, the past continuous gives the background, and the past perfect shows what happened earlier.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyada uchta zamon ishlatiladi. Past simple asosiy voqealarni, past continuous fonni, past perfect esa oldin sodir bo‘lganini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Xat yozish
board: Formal: Dear Sir or Madam, … Yours faithfully,
Formal: Dear Mr Brown, … Yours sincerely,
Informal: Hi Anna, … Best wishes / Love,

examples.t: I am writing to apply for the position of assistant.
examples.uz: Men yordamchi lavozimiga murojaat qilish uchun yozmoqdaman.

examples.t: Could you possibly send me more information?

scenes.say_native: Xat yozishda birinchi savol: bu rasmiy xatmi yoki norasmiymi. Rasmiy xat Dear Sir or Madam bilan boshlanadi va Yours faithfully bilan tugaydi. Agar ismini bilsangiz, Dear Mr Brown va Yours sincerely. Norasmiy xatda Hi yoki Dear bilan boshlanib, Best wishes bilan tugaydi. Rasmiy xatda qisqartmalar ishlatilmaydi: I am, can not emas. Xatni yozish sababi bilan boshlang: I am writing to.
scenes.say: First decide whether the letter is formal or informal. Formal: Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully. If you know the name: Dear Mr Brown, Yours sincerely.
scenes.say_uz: Avval xat rasmiyligini aniqlang. Rasmiy: Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully. Ismni bilsangiz: Dear Mr Brown, Yours sincerely.

scenes.title: Xatdagi uslub xatolari
board: ✗ Dear Sir, hi! I wanna ask …
✓ Dear Sir or Madam, I would like to ask …
scenes.say_native: Xatdagi eng ko‘p xato uslub aralashishi. Rasmiy xatda wanna, gonna, hi kabi so‘zlar bo‘lmaydi, ularning o‘rniga would like to deymiz. Ikkinchi xato: yakuniy iborani noto‘g‘ri tanlash. Ismni bilmasangiz, faithfully. Ismni bilsangiz, sincerely. Yana bir kichik narsa: ko‘p o‘quvchilar xatni uchinchi shaxsga mo‘ljallab yozadi, aslida siz bevosita o‘quvchiga murojaat qilasiz.
scenes.say: In a formal letter, avoid wanna and hi. Write I would like to ask. If you do not know the name, close with Yours faithfully. If you know it, use Yours sincerely.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy xatda wanna va hi ishlatmang. Ismni bilmasangiz Yours faithfully, bilsangiz Yours sincerely.

scenes.title: Qisqacha mazmun yozish
board: 1. Find the main idea of each paragraph
4. About one third of the original length

examples.t: The writer argues that cities need more green space.
examples.uz: Muallif shaharlarga ko‘proq yashil joy kerak, deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.say_native: Qisqacha mazmun yozish uchun avval har bir abzasning asosiy fikrini toping. Keyin matndan so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang, o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta ayting. Misollar va tafsilotlarni olib tashlang. Hajmi taxminan asl matnning uchdan biri bo‘lsin. Ibora tanlash ham muhim: the writer argues that, the text explains that, according to the article. Shaxsiy fikringizni qo‘shmang, faqat muallif nima degan bo‘lsa shuni yozing.
scenes.say: To write a summary, find the main idea, paraphrase it and remove examples. Use phrases like the writer argues that or according to the article.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqacha mazmun uchun asosiy fikrni toping, o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ayting va misollarni olib tashlang. The writer argues that, according to the article kabi iboralardan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Eng yaxshi qisqacha mazmun
board: Text: Many cities are building cycle lanes. Cycling is cheap and healthy, and it reduces traffic. However, some drivers complain that roads are now too narrow.
A) The text is about cities.
B) Cities are building cycle lanes because cycling has benefits, though some drivers object.
C) Drivers do not like cycling and cities.
scenes.say_native: Matnni o‘qing va qaysi qisqacha mazmun eng yaxshi ekanini ayting. A variant juda umumiy, hech narsa aytmaydi. B variantda asosiy fikr ham bor, qarshi fikr ham. C variantda esa ma’no noto‘g‘ri berilgan. Variantni tanlang va nima uchun deb o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Many cities are building cycle lanes. Cycling is cheap and healthy, and it reduces traffic. However, some drivers complain that the roads are now too narrow. Which summary is best?
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘plab shaharlar velosiped yo‘laklari qurmoqda. Velosiped arzon, sog‘lom va tirbandlikni kamaytiradi. Biroq ayrim haydovchilar yo‘llar torayib qolganidan shikoyat qiladi. Qaysi qisqacha mazmun eng yaxshi?

scenes.title: Javob: B
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob B. U ikkita narsani qamrab oladi: shaharlar yo‘lak qurayotgani sababi bilan birga va haydovchilarning e’tirozi. A variant haqiqatan to‘g‘ri, lekin foydasiz, chunki juda umumiy. C variantda haydovchilar velosipedni emas, torayib qolgan yo‘llarni yoqtirmaydi, demak ma’no buzilgan. Yaxshi qisqacha mazmun to‘liq, aniq va to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: B is the best summary. It includes the main idea and the contrast. A is too general. C changes the meaning.
scenes.say_uz: B eng yaxshi qisqacha mazmun. U asosiy fikrni va qarama-qarshilikni o‘z ichiga oladi. A juda umumiy, C ma’noni o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: O‘qish strategiyasi
board: Skim: read for the general idea (1 min)
scenes.say_native: O‘qish bo‘limida avval matnga tez ko‘z yugurtiring, bu skimming. Maqsad umumiy mavzuni tushunish. Keyin savollarni o‘qing va matndan kerakli joyni qidiring, bu scanning: ism, raqam, sana. True, False, Not given topshirig‘ida muhim qoida: matnda aytilmagan narsa Not given bo‘ladi, o‘zingizning bilimingiz bu yerda hisobga olinmaydi. Matnda qarama-qarshi gap bo‘lsa False.
scenes.say: First skim the text for the general idea. Then read the questions and scan for details. In True, False, Not given tasks, use only the text, not your own knowledge.
scenes.say_uz: Avval matnni tez ko‘zdan kechiring. Keyin savollarni o‘qing va tafsilotlarni qidiring. True, False, Not given topshirig‘ida faqat matnga tayaning.

scenes.title: O‘qish matni
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘qish matniga o‘tamiz. Biz uni tinglaymiz, siz esa kuzatib boring. Matn kichik shahar kutubxonasi haqida. Matnda raqam va sabab bor, shuning uchun diqqat bilan eshiting. Keyingi blokda savollar beriladi.
scenes.say: The town library opened in nineteen fifty. Last year it was nearly closed because fewer people were using it. However, a group of volunteers organised a campaign, and they now run reading clubs there. The library is open six days a week.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar kutubxonasi 1950-yilda ochilgan. O‘tgan yili undan foydalanuvchilar kamayganligi sababli yopilishiga oz qoldi. Biroq ko‘ngillilar guruhi kampaniya uyushtirdi va hozir u yerda kitobxonlik to‘garaklarini olib borishmoqda. Kutubxona haftasiga olti kun ochiq.

scenes.title: O‘qish savollari
board: 1) Why was the library nearly closed?
3) True / False / Not given: It is open seven days a week.
4) True / False / Not given: The council paid for the campaign.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: kutubxonaning yopilishiga sabab nima edi. Ikkinchi: kim kampaniya uyushtirdi. Uchinchi savol: kutubxona haftasiga yetti kun ochiq, True, False yoki Not given. To‘rtinchi: kengash kampaniya uchun pul to‘ladi, True, False yoki Not given. Esda tuting, faqat matnga tayaning.
scenes.say: Question one: why was the library nearly closed? Question two: who organised the campaign? Question three: it is open seven days a week. Question four: the council paid for the campaign.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: kutubxona nega yopilishiga oz qoldi? Ikkinchi: kampaniyani kim uyushtirdi? Uchinchi: u haftasiga yetti kun ochiq. To‘rtinchi: kengash kampaniya uchun pul to‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘qish javoblari
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: yopilish sababi shuki, undan foydalanuvchilar kamaygan. Ikkinchi: kampaniyani ko‘ngillilar guruhi uyushtirgan. Uchinchi: False, chunki matnda haftasiga olti kun deyilgan. To‘rtinchi: Not given, chunki kengash haqida matnda bir og‘iz ham so‘z yo‘q. Ko‘pchilik buni False deb belgilaydi, lekin False uchun matn gapni inkor qilishi kerak, bu esa shunchaki aytilmagan.
scenes.say: Fewer people were using it. A group of volunteers. False, it is open six days. Not given, because the text says nothing about the council.
scenes.say_uz: Foydalanuvchilar kamaygan edi. Ko‘ngillilar guruhi. False, olti kun ochiq. Not given, chunki matnda kengash haqida hech narsa yo‘q.

scenes.title: Birinchi tinglash: poyezd
board: Anna and Tom plan a trip
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang. Anna va Tom shanba kuni dengizga borishmoqchi. Vaqt va joy haqida ma’lumotga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob beramiz.
scenes.say: Anna: Tom, have you checked the trains for Saturday? Tom: Yes. The ten fifteen has been cancelled, so we'll have to take the eleven thirty. Anna: That's a bit late. Shall we meet at the station at eleven? Tom: Good idea. And I'll bring sandwiches, if you bring the drinks.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Tom, shanba kuniga poyezdlarni tekshirdingmi? Tom: Ha. O‘n o‘n beshdagisi bekor qilingan, shuning uchun o‘n bir o‘ttizdagisiga minishimiz kerak. Anna: Bu biroz kech. Soat o‘n birda bekatda uchrashaylikmi? Tom: Yaxshi fikr. Sendvichlarni men olib kelaman, agar sen ichimliklarni olib kelsang.

scenes.title: Birinchi suhbat savollari
board: 1) Why can't they take the 10:15 train?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: nega o‘n o‘n beshdagi poyezdga minolmaydilar. Ikkinchi: ular soat nechada uchrashadilar. Uchinchi: ichimliklarni kim olib keladi. Esda tuting, bekor qilingan poyezd soati va uchrashuv vaqti bir xil emas.
scenes.say: Question one: why can't they take the ten fifteen train? Question two: what time do they meet? Question three: who brings the drinks?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: nega 10:15 poyezdiga minolmaydilar? Ikkinchi: ular soat nechada uchrashadilar? Uchinchi: ichimliklarni kim olib keladi?

scenes.title: Birinchi suhbat javoblari
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: poyezd bekor qilingan, bu yerda majhul darajaning present perfect shakli ishlatilgan: has been cancelled. Ikkinchi: ular soat o‘n birda uchrashadi, poyezd esa o‘n bir o‘ttizda ketadi. Uchinchi: Anna ichimliklarni olib keladi, chunki Tom sendvichlarni olib kelaman dedi va shart qo‘ydi: if you bring the drinks. Ko‘ryapsizmi, suhbatda ham grammatika yashirin.
scenes.say: The train has been cancelled. They meet at eleven. Anna brings the drinks.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezd bekor qilingan. Ular soat o‘n birda uchrashadi. Ichimliklarni Anna olib keladi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi tinglash: ovozli xabar
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi matn ovozli xabar. Stomatolog qabul xonasidan qo‘ng‘iroq qilishmoqda. Kun, vaqt va nima qilish kerakligini ushlab oling. Shu uchtasi doim savolga aylanadi.
scenes.say: Hello, this is Mrs Clark from Greenfield Dental Surgery. I'm calling about your appointment on Tuesday. The dentist has been called away, so I'm afraid we'll have to move it to Thursday at half past two. If that's not convenient, please call us before Monday evening on oh one two three, five five five.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, bu Grinfild stomatologiya xonasidan missis Klark. Seshanba kungi qabulingiz haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman. Stomatolog chaqirib olindi, shuning uchun afsuski uni payshanba kuni soat ikki yarimga ko‘chirishimizga to‘g‘ri keladi. Agar bu qulay bo‘lmasa, iltimos, dushanba kechqurungacha qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

scenes.title: Ovozli xabar savollari
board: 1) Which day was the original appointment?
3) What should the listener do if Thursday is not convenient?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: asl qabul qaysi kunga belgilangan edi. Ikkinchi: yangi vaqt qanday. Uchinchi: agar payshanba noqulay bo‘lsa, nima qilish kerak va qachongacha. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Question one: which day was the original appointment? Question two: what is the new time? Question three: what should the listener do if Thursday is not convenient?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: asl qabul qaysi kun edi? Ikkinchi: yangi vaqt qanday? Uchinchi: agar payshanba noqulay bo‘lsa, nima qilish kerak?

scenes.title: Ovozli xabar javoblari
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: asl qabul seshanba kuni edi. Ikkinchi: yangi vaqt payshanba, soat ikki yarim, ya’ni half past two. Uchinchi: agar noqulay bo‘lsa, dushanba kechqurungacha qo‘ng‘iroq qilish kerak. Bu yerda xabar muloyim uslubda yozilgan: I'm afraid, if that's not convenient. Bunday iboralarni xatda ham ishlatsangiz bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The original day was Tuesday. The new time is Thursday at half past two. Call before Monday evening.
scenes.say_uz: Asl kun seshanba edi. Yangi vaqt payshanba soat ikki yarim. Dushanba kechqurungacha qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar va bog‘lanish

examples.t: I would have called you.
Turn it off.

scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi. To so‘zi to‘liq tu emas, qisqa schwa bilan, tə. Have esa əv bo‘lib qoladi, shuning uchun would have so‘zi would've kabi eshitiladi va ko‘p o‘quvchi uni would of deb yozib yuboradi, bu xato. Yana bog‘lanish bor: turn it off so‘zlari bir-biriga ulanib, bitta so‘zday eshitiladi. Buni tinglashda bilish juda foydali.
scenes.say: In natural speech, small words are weak. To becomes tə, have becomes əv. Would have sounds like would've. Words link together: turn it off.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy nutqda kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi: to tə, have əv bo‘ladi. So‘zlar bir-biriga ulanadi: turn it off.

scenes.title: Gapirishga tayyorlanish
board: Topic: A time when something went wrong
scenes.say_native: Endi gapirish. Mavzu: biror ish xato ketgan vaqtingiz. Sizga ikki daqiqalik nutq uchun reja beraman: vaziyat, nima bo‘lgani, qanday tugagani va nimani o‘rganganingiz. Hozir o‘n besh soniya o‘ylab, birinchi ikki jumlani baland ovozda ayting. Past simple, past continuous va past perfectni ishlating.
scenes.say: Your topic is: a time when something went wrong. Use four steps: the situation, what happened, how it ended, and what you learned. Say your first two sentences now.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: biror ish xato ketgan payt. To‘rt qadamdan foydalaning: vaziyat, nima bo‘lgani, qanday tugagani va nimani o‘rganganingiz. Hozir birinchi ikki gapni ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna nutq
scenes.say_native: Namuna sifatida qisqa variant. Unda o‘tgan oddiy, davomli va tugallangan zamonlar bor, bog‘lovchilar ham ishlatilgan. Siz o‘z nutqingizni uzunroq qiling, ikki daqiqaga yetguncha misol va his-tuyg‘ularni qo‘shing. Gapirayotganda to‘xtab qolsangiz, in other words yoki what I mean is kabi iboralar bilan davom eting.
scenes.say: Last year I was travelling to a job interview when my phone died. I hadn't printed the address, so I got lost. In the end I arrived forty minutes late. Luckily, the manager laughed, and now I always carry a paper map.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili ish suhbatiga ketayotganimda telefonim o‘chib qoldi. Manzilni chop etmagan edim, shuning uchun adashib qoldim. Oxirida qirq daqiqa kechikib keldim. Yaxshiyamki, menejer kulib yubordi, endi doim qog‘oz xarita olib yuraman.

scenes.title: Vaqtli yozma topshiriq
board: Task: Email a friend about a trip you want to take. Say where, when and why.
Use: if + would · going to · because
scenes.say_native: Yozma topshiriq. Uch daqiqa ichida do‘stingizga to‘rt-besh jumlalik norasmiy xat yozing: qayerga borishni xohlaysiz, qachon va nima uchun. Birinchi yoki ikkinchi tur shart gapni, going to ni va because ni ishlating. Hozir daftaringizga yozing, keyin namuna bilan taqqoslang.
scenes.say: Write an email to a friend about a trip you want to take. Say where, when and why. Use if with would, going to, and because. You have three minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘stingizga orzu qilgan sayohatingiz haqida xat yozing: qayerga, qachon va nima uchun. If bilan would, going to va because dan foydalaning. Uch daqiqangiz bor.

scenes.title: Namuna xat
scenes.say_native: Namunani o‘z yozganingiz bilan taqqoslang. Unda norasmiy salomlashish, reja uchun going to, shart gap va because bor. Tekshirib ko‘ring: sizda ham sabab, reja va shart bormi, har bir fe’l to‘g‘ri zamondami, gap bosh harf bilan boshlanib nuqta bilan tugadimi? Mayda xatolarni topish aynan shu usulda yaxshilanadi.
scenes.say: Hi Sam, I'm going to visit Samarkand in April because I've always wanted to see the Registan. If you come with me, we'll have a great time. If I had more money, I would stay a week. Write soon! Best wishes, Ali
scenes.say_uz: Salom Sem, aprelda Samarqandga boraman, chunki Registonni ko‘rishni doim xohlaganman. Men bilan kelsang, yaxshi vaqt o‘tkazamiz. Pulim ko‘proq bo‘lsa, bir hafta qolgan bo‘lardim. Tezroq yoz! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Ali

scenes.title: B1 darajasi: umumiy xulosa
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Siz zamonlar tizimini, to‘rt turdagi shart gaplarni, majhul darajani va ko‘chirma gapni takrorladingiz. Fikr bildirish, hikoya qilish, xat va qisqacha mazmun yozishni mashq qildingiz. O‘qish va tinglash strategiyalarini sinab ko‘rdingiz, kuchsiz shakllarni eshitdingiz. Bu katta yo‘l, tabriklayman. Endi test savollariga o‘ting va yutuqlaringizni tekshiring.
scenes.say: You have reviewed tenses, conditionals, the passive and reported speech. You have practised opinions, stories, letters and summaries. Well done. Now take the final test.
scenes.say_uz: Siz zamonlar, shart gaplar, majhul daraja va ko‘chirma gapni takrorladingiz. Fikr, hikoya, xat va qisqacha mazmunni mashq qildingiz. Barakalla. Endi yakuniy testni topshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: complete the B1 exam + a 2-minute talk
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: B1 imtihon testini to‘liq topshiring va o‘n beshta savoldan kamida o‘n ikkitasiga to‘g‘ri javob bering. Keyin telefoningizda ikki daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling, mavzu: biror ish xato ketgan payt yoki sizning orzuyingizdagi sayohat. Yozuvni tinglab, zamon xatolarini sanang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ikki daqiqa to‘xtamay gapirish. Keyingi darsda B1 dan B2 ga: nimalar o‘zgarishini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: take the B1 exam test and aim for at least twelve out of fifteen. Then record a two-minute talk and listen for tense mistakes. Next time we move up to level B2.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: B1 testini topshiring va kamida o‘n ikki ball to‘plang. Keyin ikki daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling va zamon xatolarini tinglang. Keyingi darsda B2 darajasiga o‘tamiz.

homework_uz: B1 imtihon testini topshiring (kamida 12/15) va telefoningizda 2 daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling (mavzu: ish xato ketgan payt yoki orzuyingizdagi sayohat). Yozuvni tinglab, zamon xatolarini sanang. Muvaffaqiyat: to‘xtamasdan 2 daqiqa gapirish.

quiz.why_uz: Since bilan davom etayotgan holat uchun present perfect ishlatiladi: has lived.
Qo‘ng‘iroq paytida davom etayotgan harakat uchun past continuous: were having.

quiz.q: If I ___ more time, I would help you.
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi shart gapda if dan keyin o‘tgan zamon: had. Will va would if dan keyin kelmaydi.

quiz.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
quiz.why_uz: Birinchi tur shart gapda if dan keyin oddiy hozirgi zamon: rains.

quiz.q: If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.
quiz.why_uz: Uchinchi tur: if + past perfect, would have + uchinchi shakl.
O‘tgan zamondagi majhul daraja: was built.
Hozir davom etayotgan majhul harakat: is being repaired.
Ko‘chirma savolda oddiy so‘z tartibi: where I lived.
Tell dan keyin kishi kerak: she told me. Say dan keyin esa kishi kelmaydi.

quiz.q: 'I will call you,' he said. → He said he ___ me.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘chirma gapda will would ga o‘tadi.

quiz.q: We need to make a ___ before Friday.
quiz.why_uz: Make a decision hamroh so‘zi. Homework bilan do ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Choose the correct noun: He showed great ___.
quiz.why_uz: Great dan keyin ot kerak: kindness.

quiz.q: You do not know the name of the person. You end a formal letter with:
quiz.why_uz: Ismni bilmasangiz Dear Sir or Madam bilan boshlab, Yours faithfully bilan tugatiladi.

quiz.q: In a True / False / Not given task, the text says nothing about the topic. Answer:
quiz.why_uz: Matnda umuman aytilmagan narsa Not given. Shaxsiy bilim hisobga olinmaydi.

quiz.q: The best summary of a text should be:
options: a copy of the first paragraph
about one third of the length, in your own words
quiz.why_uz: Qisqacha mazmun o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan, ixcham va misollarsiz bo‘ladi.
